Akali.build: The guide does not name a specific first item to buy. Build magic resistance against Akali’s main damage and get enough health to survive the execute damage from Akali R Perfect Execution.
Akali.combo: Use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element, then dash to Akali with Qiyana E Audacity and cast Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash. Weave in an auto attack, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to get a different element, reset Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal and the passive, and cast Q again. If you can push Akali into a wall, stun her first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then switch elements and follow up with Q and an auto attack.
Akali.escape: If only one mobility spell is down, Akali can escape with the other, so look for an opening especially before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up. Before going in, check which terrain you’ll target with Qiyana W Terrashape when retreating.
Akali.fight: Use Qiyana W Terrashape to get the brush element and approach. Follow with Qiyana E Audacity and Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, then switch elements with the W Terrashape you saved and disengage.
Akali.laning: Qiyana should choose short engagements where she goes in and comes back out rather than extended fights. Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river to collect elements.
Akali.phase: Engaging becomes riskier late game, so use the advantages you gained in mid game to take objectives and turrets and end the game sooner.
Akali.teamfight: If the enemy team groups near Akali in a narrow passage, by the river, or near brush, start the fight by pushing them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there’s no such angle, let your team engage first and wait for the enemy to use their abilities, then enter the backline with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity. Before going in, check which terrain you’ll use when retreating.
Akali.watch: If the mark is applied, the second dash follows Qiyana as she tries to escape.

Akshan.fight: The moment after Akshan E Heroic Swing is used is your chance to close the gap. Get an element with Qiyana W Terrashape, then engage with Qiyana E Audacity and cast Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash. Akshan P Dirty Fighting grants a shield and bonus movement speed, so don’t trade auto attacks for long. Save Qiyana W Terrashape for another use and keep terrain available for your escape.
Akshan.build: Akshan’s main ability damage is physical, so build armor first. Basic attacks and attack speed are also key parts of his damage, so anything that reduces his attack speed can help.
Akshan.combo: First, use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element. Once Akshan E Heroic Swing has been fully spent, dash in with Qiyana E Audacity. If you can push him into a wall, stun him first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then switch elements and finish with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal and an auto attack.
Akshan.escape: Go in immediately after Akshan E Heroic Swing has been fully spent. Close the gap with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity, but check which terrain you’ll use for another Qiyana W Terrashape and your retreat route.
Akshan.laning: Get the brush element to approach, then after trading use Qiyana W Terrashape to select different terrain and disengage. Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river and keep vision around the river and jungle walls where Akshan W Going Rogue can provide a camouflage route.
Akshan.phase: Qiyana peaks in mid game, so push waves and use the advantages you gain by moving around to pressure objectives and turrets. Late game, it’s hard to kill opponents with stacked defensive items in one go, so choose your engages carefully.
Akshan.teamfight: If you have Akshan’s Scoundrel mark after killing one of his allies, don’t face Akshan alone or stay within his finishing range. If the enemy team groups by the river or in a narrow passage, stun them by pushing them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there’s no such angle, let your team engage first and wait for the enemy to use their abilities before entering the backline. Check which terrain you’ll use with Qiyana W Terrashape when retreating.
Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits an enemy, so dodge its outbound and return paths even from behind a minion wave. Watch the path Akshan E Heroic Swing takes around walls and where he exits. When your health is low, if Akshan R Comeuppance shows its targeting indicator, get behind terrain to block the shots.

Ahri.teamfight: If Ahri groups near terrain by the river or in a narrow passage, start the teamfight by pushing her into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there’s no such angle, let your team engage first and wait for Ahri E Charm to be used, then enter the backline with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity. Before going in, check which terrain you’ll use when retreating.
Ahri.laning: Keep a line of minions between you and Ahri to block Ahri E Charm, and take short trades when she steps forward to last hit. Don’t use Qiyana E Audacity to farm; clear the wave with auto attacks while an element is active. Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river to collect elements.
Ahri.build: Get a way to interrupt or remove Ahri E Charm first, and build magic resistance against Ahri’s magic damage. Magic resistance does not reduce the true damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception. If Ahri’s healing from Ahri P Essence Theft is keeping her alive through your assassination attempt, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Ahri.combo: Use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element, then press Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal while dashing to Ahri with Qiyana E Audacity, and follow with an auto attack. Then use Qiyana W Terrashape to select different terrain, reset Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal and Qiyana P Royal Privilege, and attack again. If you can push Ahri into a wall, stun her first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then switch elements and follow up.
Ahri.escape: Engage just after Ahri E Charm is used or while Ahri R Spirit Rush is unavailable. Before going in, check which terrain you’ll target with Qiyana W Terrashape when retreating.
Ahri.fight: Take a short trade immediately after dodging Ahri E Charm from behind minions or baiting it out. Use an element collected from brush to create an approach angle with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, close in with Qiyana E Audacity, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to select different terrain and disengage.
Ahri.phase: Early on, Qiyana struggles to fight ranged opponents for long, so look only for short trades. Late game, it becomes harder to take opponents down in one go, so use your mid-game lead to pressure objectives and turrets.
Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits you, you can take her entire follow-up combo, so dodge it by keeping minions between you. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit on the return as well, and that damage is true damage, so after dodging the first pass, move out of its return path too.

Syndra.combo: After getting the brush element with Qiyana W Terrashape, dash at Syndra with Qiyana E Audacity once Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down. While dashing, press Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal toward Syndra. Land an auto attack, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to get a different element, reset Q and your passive, and use Q again. If you can push Syndra into a wall, stun her first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then continue with the rest of your attacks.
Syndra.escape: Syndra has no mobility, but Syndra E Scatter the Weak is her self-peel, so go in with Qiyana E Audacity after E is down. Before going in, check which terrain to target with Qiyana W Terrashape so you have a Q reset and an escape route.
Syndra.laning: Early on, avoid extended trades with ranged Syndra and look for short trades around brush. If Syndra’s sphere is between Qiyana and Syndra, move out of the stun line. Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river to secure an element and look for advantages elsewhere.
Syndra.build: Buy boots early to get movement speed, which makes it easier to walk out of Syndra’s skillshots.
Syndra.fight: The moment after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is used is your chance to engage. First, get an element with Qiyana W Terrashape in the brush. When Syndra steps forward to last-hit minions, trade briefly with Qiyana E Audacity and Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. Use Qiyana W Terrashape again to reset Q and secure terrain you can retreat to.
Syndra.phase: Early on, Qiyana should avoid extended fights with ranged opponents and trade briefly. Engaging becomes more dangerous late, so use your midgame lead to take objectives and turrets and end the game sooner.
Syndra.teamfight: If the enemy team groups near the river or in a narrow passage, start a team fight by pushing them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there’s no such angle, let your allies engage first, then enter the backline with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down. Move away from areas where Syndra has placed several spheres, since Syndra R Unleashed Power is dangerous there, and check which terrain you can retreat to before going in.
Syndra.watch: Syndra E Scatter the Weak pushes nearby spheres to stun, so move out of their line when you see a sphere. Syndra W Force of Will slows and deals true damage, and Syndra R Unleashed Power can execute low-health targets, so avoid forcing your way in when health has decreased.

Ambessa.phase: Both champions are strong in mid game, so turn Qiyana’s mid-game lead into objectives and turrets, and don’t force engages on opponents with defensive items in late game.
Ambessa.build: If Ambessa’s healing is stopping your assassination, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items. Armor is the resistance to build against the damage from Ambessa P Drakehound's Step, Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam, and W Repudiation. Since she has max-health damage and penetration, don’t take extended fights with only health or resistance built.
Ambessa.combo: Prepare Qiyana W Terrashape with the brush element, then engage with E Audacity when Ambessa W Repudiation and her main attacks are used. Press Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash and follow with an auto attack. Then use W Terrashape to get a different element, reset Q and the passive, and cast Q again. If you can push her into a wall or the river, stun her first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then use your remaining attacks.
Ambessa.escape: Your window to engage is immediately after Ambessa has spent her ability-triggered dashes and empowered basic attacks and the slow from Ambessa E Lacerate has also been used up. Close in with Qiyana E Audacity, but save W Terrashape for the Q reset and your escape. When she starts to retaliate, use the brush-element Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal to break vision and retreat toward the terrain you picked.
Ambessa.fight: Keep your distance while Ambessa can dash with her abilities, and attack briefly just after she uses her abilities and empowered auto attacks. If Ambessa W Repudiation is being prepared, use Qiyana’s brush-element Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal to break vision and get out of range. If Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam is hard to dodge completely, getting close to her body reduces the damage compared with taking the blade edge.
Ambessa.laning: Prepare the brush element, use Qiyana E Audacity and Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal to engage, then keep a route open to retreat with W Terrashape. Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river. If the wave is pushing toward your side, clear it first.
Ambessa.teamfight: If Ambessa groups with allies in a narrow passage or by the river, try to stun them by pushing them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there’s no such angle, let your team engage first and wait for Ambessa W Repudiation and crowd control to be used before entering the backline. Before going in, check which terrain you’ll use Qiyana W Terrashape on when retreating, and don’t stand in a straight line with your backline against Ambessa R Public Execution.
Ambessa.watch: When you see the shield and windup from Ambessa W Repudiation, stop attacking and move out of range. If Ambessa E Lacerate slows you, immediately move with Qiyana W Terrashape to dodge the blade edge of the follow-up Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam. Ambessa R Public Execution targets the farthest champion in a straight line, so don’t line up with your backline when facing her.

Ryze.phase: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so pressure him with short trades, but avoid extended fights as Qiyana too. Later, it becomes harder to engage on opponents with defensive items, so pick your angles carefully.
Ryze.build: Ryze’s main damage is magic damage, so buy a magic resistance item first. Get movement speed to help you leave the area of his telegraphed attacks.
Ryze.combo: Use Qiyana W Terrashape to get the brush or river element, then press Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal while dashing to Ryze with Qiyana E Audacity. After an auto attack, use W to get an element from different terrain, reset Q and your passive, then use Q again. If you can push him into a wall, stun him first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then follow up with the rest of your attacks.
Ryze.escape: Engage after dodging Ryze E Spell Flux or when Ryze W Rune Prison is down.
Ryze.fight: When Ryze steps forward to last-hit minions, approach with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal while holding the brush element and trade briefly. If you go in with Qiyana E Audacity, save Qiyana W Terrashape for your second Q and your escape.
Ryze.laning: Early on, avoid extended fights and pressure Ryze’s growth with brief trades before he gets his items. Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river to get an element.
Ryze.teamfight: Don’t let Ryze keep hitting you from range, and move away from allies if Ryze E Spell Flux marks you. If the enemy team groups near the river or in a narrow passage, push them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. Otherwise, let your allies engage first, then enter the backline after the enemy abilities are used. Before going in, use Qiyana W Terrashape to check which terrain you can retreat to.
Ryze.watch: If Ryze E Spell Flux hits you, keep your distance from Ryze and stay apart from your allies until the mark disappears. After the mark is applied, Ryze W Rune Prison roots you, and the following Ryze Q Overload deals more damage, so dodge E first.

Anivia.build: Anivia Q Flash Frost, E Frostbite, and R Glacial Storm deal mainly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Movement speed to get out of slows is also useful. If Anivia is surviving with healing, consider Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Anivia.combo: Before engaging, use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element. Dash to Anivia with Qiyana E Audacity while using Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, then follow with an auto attack. Next, use Qiyana W Terrashape to get a different element, reset Q and Qiyana P Royal Privilege, then cast Q again. If you can push her into a wall, stun her first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then follow up with damage.
Anivia.escape: Anivia has no mobility abilities, so closing the gap with Qiyana E Audacity after Anivia Q Flash Frost has been fully spent is a good option. Save Qiyana W Terrashape for a follow-up Q and your escape route.
Anivia.fight: Once Anivia Q Flash Frost has been fully spent, carry the brush element and approach for a short fight. Close in with Qiyana E Audacity, use Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash, and follow with an auto attack. Then use Qiyana W Terrashape to switch elements and set up an escape route. If Anivia P Rebirth is still available, go in with an ally rather than trying to break the egg alone.
Anivia.laning: Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river to collect elements. Don’t leave a wave that’s pushing toward your side unattended.
Anivia.phase: After learning Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent and getting core items in mid game, use terrain to secure kills and turn the lead into objectives and turrets. Late game, Qiyana’s assassination engages become harder and Anivia’s terrain control becomes a problem, so use your mid-game lead to end the game sooner.
Anivia.teamfight: Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape on narrow paths, so before going in, check which terrain you’ll target with Qiyana W Terrashape and where you’ll retreat. If the enemy team groups near the river or brush and Anivia’s crowd control is used, start the fight by pushing them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there’s no such angle, let your team engage first and draw out the enemy abilities, then enter the backline with Qiyana E Audacity.
Anivia.watch: Dodge both the path of Anivia Q Flash Frost and the spot where it detonates when recast. If you’re hit by Q or remain inside Anivia R Glacial Storm after it grows large enough, Anivia E Frostbite deals more damage, so use Qiyana W Terrashape or Qiyana E Audacity to get out of the storm. On narrow paths, Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape route.

Annie.build: Annie’s damage is magic, so build magic resistance before armor to survive one combo. Tenacity is also worth considering because getting locked down by Annie P Pyromania’s stun is especially dangerous. Get movement speed to help you leave the area of her area-of-effect attacks.
Annie.combo: First, use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element, then press Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during your Qiyana E Audacity dash to Annie and hit her. Follow with an auto attack, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to select different terrain, reset Q and Qiyana P Royal Privilege, and cast Q once more. If you can push her into a wall, stun her first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then use your remaining attacks.
Annie.escape: The chance to engage comes just after Annie P Pyromania’s stun is used. Annie has no mobility abilities, so close the gap with Qiyana E Audacity, but check in advance which terrain you’ll target with Qiyana W Terrashape to escape after attacking.
Annie.fight: After Annie P Pyromania’s stun is used, take a short trade when Annie steps forward to last hit. Use an element collected from brush to cast Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, close in with Qiyana E Audacity, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to select different terrain and create an opening for another attack or an escape route.
Annie.laning: Early on, Qiyana has low health, so don’t take extended fights with Annie. Keep your distance while her stun is ready. Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river to collect elements with Qiyana W Terrashape and look for advantages elsewhere.
Annie.phase: Early on, Qiyana should focus on short trades rather than extended fights, and back off while Annie’s stun is ready. Engaging becomes riskier late game, so use your mid-game lead to take objectives and turrets.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready or Annie is out of sight, stand apart from your allies so you aren’t all hit by Annie R Summon: Tibbers. If the enemy team groups by the river or in a narrow passage, push them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there’s no such angle, let your team engage first and wait for Annie’s stun and defensive abilities to be used before entering the backline.
Annie.watch: If white light is swirling around Annie, Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready, so don’t enter ability range. Keep your distance so you aren’t hit by Annie R Summon: Tibbers and her area-of-effect abilities together, and don’t stay near Tibbers after killing Annie.

AurelionSol.build: Build magic resistance first against Aurelion Sol’s main damage. Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on max health, so consider movement speed to get out of Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, rather than relying only on health.
AurelionSol.combo: Use Qiyana W Terrashape to get the brush element and engage with Qiyana E Audacity. Press Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash and follow with an auto attack. Then use Qiyana W Terrashape to get a different element, reset Q and the passive, and cast Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal again. If you can push him into a wall, stun him first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then use your remaining attacks.
AurelionSol.escape: The chance to engage comes just after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is used. Avoid Aurelion Sol E Singularity’s area and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, then close in with Qiyana E Audacity. Use Qiyana W Terrashape with a route in mind for pursuing or escaping.
AurelionSol.fight: Early on, approach briefly with the brush element when Aurelion Sol steps forward to last hit. When Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is used, close in with Qiyana E Audacity and save Qiyana W Terrashape to enable a second Q and an escape route.
AurelionSol.laning: Pressure Aurelion Sol with short trades early, before he stacks stardust, but don’t keep taking Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light hits and help him scale. Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river and collect elements with Qiyana W Terrashape.
AurelionSol.phase: Early on, Aurelion Sol has little stardust and low armor, so Qiyana can pressure him. Qiyana gets stronger in mid game, so use your lead then to take objectives and turrets. Late game, watch out for Aurelion Sol’s permanently stacked stardust and empowered Aurelion Sol R The Skies Descend.
AurelionSol.teamfight: If the enemy team groups near terrain by the river or in a narrow passage, push them into it and stun them with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there’s no such angle, let your team engage first and wait for the enemy to use their abilities, then enter the backline with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity. Keep distance from your allies so you aren’t all hit by the empowered Aurelion Sol R The Skies Descend, and check which terrain you’ll retreat to before going in.
AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals extra damage and stacks stardust if it keeps hitting one target, so stand behind minions and leave its aim line quickly. When your health is low, dodge Aurelion Sol E Singularity, which can execute you, and spread out so multiple allies aren’t hit by the empowered Aurelion Sol R The Skies Descend.

Aurora.build: Qiyana’s physical damage is effective against Aurora, who has relatively low armor, so get burst damage from your core items. If healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration disrupts your assassination, buy Executioner's Calling between your core items. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Aurora’s damage.
Aurora.combo: Use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element, then hit Aurora with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during your Qiyana E Audacity dash to her. Follow with an auto attack, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element from different terrain, reset Q and the passive, and cast Q again. If you can push her into a wall, stun her first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then switch elements and finish with Q and an auto attack.
Aurora.escape: While Aurora W Across the Veil has her stealthed, don’t rush into a targeted engage; wait for her to reappear. Your chance to engage comes when both Aurora E The Weirding and W Across the Veil are down and she hasn’t reset her leap by participating in a takedown.
Aurora.fight: Bait Aurora E The Weirding, then look for a chance to engage again. Before the fight, use Qiyana W Terrashape to get the element you need, and check which terrain you’ll use to retreat after a short burst. If health has decreased while Aurora Q Twofold Hex’s curse is active, don’t prolong the trade.
Aurora.laning: Early on, look for a short trade when Aurora steps forward to last hit rather than taking an extended fight. Use the brush element to approach with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, close in with Qiyana E Audacity and deal damage, then retreat with Qiyana W Terrashape. Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river and look for elements and opportunities to gain an advantage elsewhere.
Aurora.phase: During Qiyana’s strong mid game, turn your lead into objectives and turrets. In late game, don’t force engages on opponents with defensive items.
Aurora.teamfight: If Aurora is near terrain by the river or in a narrow passage, look to stun her by pushing her into it with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there’s no such angle, let your team engage first and wait for the enemy to use their abilities, then enter the backline with Qiyana W Terrashape and E Audacity. Look for the moment when Aurora has used her leap to engage but hasn’t participated in a takedown. When retreating, don’t leave low-health allies behind.
Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, it deals damage again when it returns, and the return damage increases the more health you’ve lost. After the curse is applied, move out of the line between you and Aurora, and if your health is low, retreat before it returns. When Aurora R Between Worlds appears, you’ll be slowed when leaving it, so decide whether to escape before the zone appears or fight inside it.

Azir.build: Build magic resistance before armor to withstand Azir's damage. The source doesn't specify a first purchase, so that can't be determined.
Azir.combo: Get an element with Qiyana W Terrashape, then dash at Azir with Qiyana E Audacity while casting Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. Weave in a basic attack, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to get a different element and cast Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal again. If you can knock him into a wall, stun him first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then switch elements and deal damage.
Azir.escape: Right after you make Azir use Azir E Shifting Sands is your window to close the gap with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity. If Azir has summoned a soldier beyond a wall, he can use Azir E Shifting Sands toward it, so account for his escape route when engaging. If Azir R Emperor's Divide is still available, also check where it could knock you back.
Azir.fight: When a soldier is standing still or Azir E Shifting Sands is down, circle around the soldier and briefly get close to Azir himself. Use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element and Qiyana E Audacity to engage, but also use Qiyana W Terrashape to disengage so you don't take counterattacks for long.
Azir.laning: Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river to get an element and slow Azir's scaling with your jungler.
Azir.phase: Qiyana gets much stronger after learning Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent and peaks in the mid game, so use the advantages you gain then to take objectives and turrets. If the game goes long, Azir gets stronger and Qiyana has a harder time finishing opponents with a single engage.
Azir.teamfight: Don't engage all at once in a narrow passage, where Azir R Emperor's Divide could knock several of you back together. If Azir's team groups near the river or brush, look to stun them by knocking them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there is no such angle, let your team engage first, then enter the enemy backline after Azir's defensive abilities are down. Check the terrain you'll target when retreating in advance.
Azir.watch: Avoid the attack range of soldiers summoned by Azir W Arise! and the paths they travel when Azir Q Conquering Sands moves them. Azir R Emperor's Divide knocks back an engaging Qiyana, so don't charge straight into Azir's team, especially in narrow passages.

Cassiopeia.build: If Cassiopeia E Twin Fang's healing is stopping your assassination, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, W Miasma, and E Twin Fang all deal magic damage, so choose magic resistance when building defenses.
Cassiopeia.combo: Get an element with Qiyana W Terrashape, then engage with Qiyana E Audacity and hit Cassiopeia with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash. Weave in a basic attack, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to get a different element and reset Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal and your passive before attacking again. If you can knock her into a wall, stun her first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then switch elements and keep attacking.
Cassiopeia.escape: Cassiopeia has no mobility, so the moment after she uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere is your chance to engage. If Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze is still available, be ready to turn your back during its cast animation. Before engaging, check which terrain you’ll target with Qiyana W Terrashape when retreating.
Cassiopeia.fight: Close the gap with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity before Cassiopeia W Miasma is placed or just after she uses it elsewhere. Catch her with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal using the river element, or stun her with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent when you can use terrain, then deal your damage in a short burst. Don't continue the fight if Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast has hit you.
Cassiopeia.laning: After engaging with Qiyana E Audacity and hitting Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, keep Qiyana W Terrashape available for your escape route. Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river to look for opportunities in other lanes and the jungle.
Cassiopeia.phase: Cassiopeia's sustained damage is strong late game, so don't fight her head-on for long.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: If Cassiopeia is near a narrow passage, the river, or brush, look to stun her by knocking her into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there is no such angle, let your team engage first, then enter the enemy backline after Cassiopeia W Miasma is used elsewhere. Catch her first with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal using the river element or Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, and finish her before she can deal sustained damage.
Cassiopeia.watch: If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, get out of range until the poison wears off. You can't use Qiyana W Terrashape or Qiyana E Audacity in Cassiopeia W Miasma, so move along a path that avoids the clouds. When you see the cast animation for Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, turn your back to avoid the stun.

Corki.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Corki E Gatling Gun and Corki R Missile Barrage. You also need health to withstand the true damage from Corki P Hextech Munitions, which resistances don't reduce. While Corki E Gatling Gun is reducing your resistances, getting out of its frontal area takes priority over building more resistance.
Corki.combo: Get the brush element with Qiyana W Terrashape, then engage with Qiyana E Audacity when Corki W Valkyrie is down. Cast Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash, then basic attack. Use Qiyana W Terrashape to get a different element and cast the reset Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal again. If you have an angle near a wall or the river, knock Corki into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent to stun him, then follow up with your remaining attacks.
Corki.escape: Your window to engage is immediately after Corki W Valkyrie has been spent. At that point, close the gap with Qiyana E Audacity and Qiyana W Terrashape, and if you have the river element, catch him with the root from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. Before engaging, also check which terrain you’ll target with Qiyana W Terrashape when retreating.
Corki.fight: Make Corki use Corki W Valkyrie first; if you force an engage while it's available, he can escape over terrain. Once Corki W Valkyrie is down, get the element you need with Qiyana W Terrashape and approach with Qiyana E Audacity. Deal damage briefly, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to switch elements and secure an escape route.
Corki.laning: Use the brush element for a short trade when Corki steps forward to last-hit minions. Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river to look for opportunities in other lanes or the jungle.
Corki.phase: After learning Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, use terrain stuns to create kill opportunities and turn your mid-game strength into objectives and turrets. Late game, Corki can accumulate items and fire missiles from a safe position, making Qiyana's engages more dangerous, so cut off Corki's farming before then.
Corki.teamfight: If Corki is near terrain by the river or a narrow passage, look to knock him into it with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent and stun him. If there is no such angle, let your team engage first, then enter from the back with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity after the enemy's abilities are down. Look for the moment Corki W Valkyrie is down, and check the terrain you'll target when retreating before you engage.
Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also damages targets near the first one it hits, so don't hide behind minions; get out of range. Reposition especially to avoid getting hit by the third missile in succession. Corki E Gatling Gun reduces your armor and magic resistance, so move to the side instead of staying in front of him. While Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb reveals your position, use Qiyana W Terrashape without hesitation to create distance.

Diana.build: Prioritize magic resistance over armor against Diana's damage. Also consider movement speed so you can leave the areas where Diana can deal damage.
Diana.combo: If Diana W Pale Cascade is down and you dodge Diana Q Crescent Strike, get an element with Qiyana W Terrashape, then engage with Qiyana E Audacity. Cast Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash and basic attack, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to get a different element and cast the reset Q again. If you can knock her into a wall, stun her first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then follow up with your remaining attacks.
Diana.escape: The moment after Diana uses Diana E Lunar Rush without hitting Diana Q Crescent Strike is your chance to engage. Close the gap with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity, then catch her with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal or Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If Diana Q Crescent Strike hits you, Diana E may reset, so don't engage; create distance instead.
Diana.fight: Trade briefly after the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are gone. If Diana engages first with Diana E Lunar Rush without Diana Q Crescent Strike, counterattack by catching her with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal or stunning her with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent.
Diana.laning: Get an element with Qiyana W Terrashape, and use the brush element for a brief trade when Diana steps forward to hit minions.
Diana.phase: Late game, it's hard to take down opponents with stacked defensive items in one go, so choose your engages carefully.
Diana.teamfight: Spread out based on your approach so several of you aren't pulled in together by Diana R Moonfall, and watch the flanks. If the enemy groups near the river or in a narrow passage, knock them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there is no such angle, let your team engage first and draw out the enemy's abilities, then enter from the back. Check in advance which terrain to target with Qiyana W Terrashape when retreating.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it flies, so dodge to the side instead of only backing away. If it hits and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush may reset, so create distance. Don't stay close and fight just after Diana activates Diana W Pale Cascade; wait for its shield and orbs to disappear.

Ekko.build: Build magic resistance over armor against Ekko's damage. If you can't use Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity, consider tenacity first to deal with the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence. If the healing from Ekko R Chronobreak is stopping your assassination, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Ekko.combo: Get an element with Qiyana W Terrashape, then dash at Ekko with Qiyana E Audacity and use Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash. Weave in a basic attack, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element from different terrain and reset Q and Qiyana P Royal Privilege before casting Q once more. If you can knock Ekko into a wall, stun him first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then switch elements and deal the rest of your damage.
Ekko.escape: The chance to fully engage comes when both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down. Don't engage right away just because Ekko E Phase Dive is down; also check whether Ekko R Chronobreak is available. Before engaging, choose the terrain you'll retreat to with Qiyana W Terrashape, then close the gap with Qiyana E Audacity.
Ekko.fight: When you see the indicator for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, move out of range and let its charge time pass. Counterattack just after Ekko E Phase Dive connects, using the root from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal or the stun from Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If Ekko R Chronobreak is still available, trade briefly and engage in earnest once it's down.
Ekko.laning: Before the fight, get the element you need with Qiyana W Terrashape, then use the brush element to approach briefly. When Ekko steps forward to last-hit minions, trade with Qiyana E Audacity and Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, then disengage with Qiyana W Terrashape. Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river to get an element and find opportunities to affect other lanes.
Ekko.phase: Qiyana is strong in the mid game, so turn the advantages you gain into objectives and turrets. Late game, it's harder to kill opponents with defensive items in one go, so choose your engages carefully. The source alone doesn't establish whether Ekko or Qiyana is stronger in each phase.
Ekko.teamfight: Avoid Ekko W Parallel Convergence's marked area, and just after Ekko E Phase Dive connects, look to catch him with the root from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal or the stun from Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If enemies group near a narrow passage, the river, or brush, knock them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there is no such angle, let your team engage first and draw out the enemy's abilities, then enter from the back with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity.
Ekko.watch: When you see the indicator for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the marked area to avoid the stun and shield. Even if Ekko Q Timewinder hits you, move out of the return path. While Ekko R Chronobreak is available, don't chase recklessly even if he looks low on health.

Fizz.build: Prioritize magic resistance over armor against Fizz's main damage. The source doesn't specify a first item, so the purchase order can't be determined.
Fizz.combo: Get an element with Qiyana W Terrashape, then engage with Qiyana E Audacity when Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down. Cast Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash and basic attack, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to get a different element and cast the reset Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal again. If you can knock him into a wall, stun him first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then use your remaining attacks.
Fizz.escape: Even if Fizz Q Urchin Strike is down, don't rush in while Fizz E Playful / Trickster is available. In particular, close the gap with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity before Fizz E Playful / Trickster comes back up, then use Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal or Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent.
Fizz.fight: Go in briefly just after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down. Get an element with Qiyana W Terrashape, close in with Qiyana E Audacity, and hit Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. Then use the Qiyana W Terrashape you kept available to switch elements and attack again or retreat.
Fizz.laning: Look to trade when Fizz's empowered basic attack from Fizz W Seastone Trident misses a last-hit and its full cooldown starts. Use the brush element to briefly go in and out, then push the wave toward the enemy turret and move along the river.
Fizz.phase: Qiyana is strong in the mid game, so use the advantages you gain then to pressure objectives and turrets. Engaging is riskier late game, so go in after the enemy's abilities, including Fizz's, are down.
Fizz.teamfight: If Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies. When Fizz goes in, stay close to your team so they can draw out Fizz E Playful / Trickster first. Once Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, focus him with your team. If the enemy groups near the river or a narrow passage, knock them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there is no such angle, dive into the back line after your team engages.
Fizz.watch: Fizz E Playful / Trickster can be used to both engage and disengage, so don't rush Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal or Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent while it's available. If Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts.

Galio.build: The source doesn't specify a first purchase. Qiyana's main physical damage is effective against Galio's low armor. Against Galio's damage, prioritize magic resistance over armor, and be cautious about building mostly health because Galio Q Winds of War deals damage based on maximum health.
Galio.combo: First get an element with Qiyana W Terrashape. When Galio W Shield of Durand is down, engage with Qiyana E Audacity and cast Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash. Basic attack, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element from different terrain, reset Q and your passive, and cast Q again. If you can knock Galio into a wall, stun him first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then switch elements and use Q and a basic attack.
Galio.escape: Look to engage after Galio W Shield of Durand's taunt and Galio E Justice Punch are down. If only one mobility ability is down, check whether Galio R Hero's Entrance is still available. Close the gap with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity before R comes back up.
Galio.fight: After Galio W Shield of Durand is down, briefly trade with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal using the brush element and Qiyana E Audacity. If Galio E Justice Punch is still available, watch for its windup and dodge before engaging. After the trade, use Qiyana W Terrashape to target different terrain and either cast Q again or secure an escape route.
Galio.laning: Push the lane when Galio has used his abilities to clear the wave and his mana has decreased. After pushing the wave toward the enemy turret, move along the river to get an element and look for opportunities in other lanes or the jungle. Don't leave when the wave is pulling toward your side.
Galio.phase: Early game, Qiyana should focus on short trades rather than extended fights, using physical damage to pressure Galio's low armor. Late game, it's harder to engage opponents with stacked defensive items, so use your mid-game advantage to take objectives and turrets.
Galio.teamfight: While Galio R Hero's Entrance is available, don't start a small fight with Galio's team in another lane. If enemies group near a narrow passage or the river, look to stun them by knocking them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there is no such angle, let your team engage first and draw out Galio's crowd control and defensive abilities, then enter the back line with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity.
Galio.watch: When Galio charges Galio W Shield of Durand, he takes reduced damage and the taunt lasts longer, so don't spend your damage; retreat out of range. Dodge Galio E Justice Punch when you see him step backward during its windup, and move out of the spot where the two gusts from Galio Q Winds of War overlap. If you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance, leave the area immediately.

Hwei.build: Build magic resistance before armor against Hwei's damage. Since Hwei Q Subject: Disaster deals damage based on maximum health, consider movement speed so you can leave the indicated attack area instead of building mostly health.
Hwei.combo: Get the brush element with Qiyana W Terrashape, then dash at Hwei with Qiyana E Audacity while casting Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. Weave in a basic attack, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element from different terrain, reset Q and Qiyana P Royal Privilege, and cast Q once more. If you can knock Hwei into a wall, the river, or brush, stun him first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then use your remaining attacks.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility, so close the gap with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity just after Hwei E Subject: Torment is down. While Hwei E Subject: Torment is available, he can push you back or root you as you engage, so confirm that he's used it.
Hwei.fight: The moment after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used to poke or clear the wave is your chance to engage. Approach with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal using the brush element, then close in with Qiyana E Audacity. Keep Qiyana W Terrashape available for follow-up attacks and disengaging.
Hwei.laning: Early game, don't fight Hwei for long. Briefly trade through the brush when he steps forward to last-hit minions. Don't use Qiyana E Audacity to farm; conserve mana with basic attacks while holding an element. Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river.
Hwei.phase: In the mid game, when you have one or two core items, turn your advantage into objectives and turrets. Late game, it's harder to take down opponents with stacked defensive items in one go, and engaging becomes more dangerous.
Hwei.teamfight: If Hwei is near terrain by the river or a narrow passage, look for an angle to knock him into it with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent and stun him. If there is no such angle, let your team engage first, then enter the back line after Hwei E Subject: Torment is down. Before engaging, check which terrain to target with Qiyana W Terrashape when retreating.
Hwei.watch: If Hwei E Subject: Torment roots or pulls you in, you're likely to get hit by the follow-up attack too. If the first spell hits, immediately reposition with Qiyana W Terrashape to dodge the second spell and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster can deal damage based on your maximum or missing health, so be especially wary of follow-up attacks when your health is low.

Irelia.combo: Get an element with Qiyana W Terrashape, then dash to Irelia with Qiyana E Audacity and cast Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash. Weave in a basic attack, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to target different terrain, reset Q and Qiyana P Royal Privilege, and cast Q again. If you have an angle to knock her into a wall, first stun her with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then switch elements and land Q and a basic attack.
Irelia.escape: Right after you bait Irelia into using Q Bladesurge is your opening to close the gap with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity. Confirm that the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet is also no longer available before going in, and decide ahead of time which terrain to target with Qiyana W Terrashape when retreating.
Irelia.fight: Right after you bait Irelia into using Q Bladesurge, engage briefly if Irelia E Flawless Duet is also down. Prepare an element with Qiyana W Terrashape, close in with Qiyana E Audacity, and land Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal and a basic attack. Then use the Qiyana W Terrashape you saved to target the next element.
Irelia.laning: Before moving elsewhere, push the wave toward the enemy turret.
Irelia.phase: Late game, it becomes harder to take down a target in one burst, so use your midgame lead to take objectives and turrets.
Irelia.teamfight: Prioritize Irelia, since Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet can have a major impact in teamfights. If Irelia is near the river, brush, or a narrow passage, look for an angle to stun her by knocking her into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there’s no such angle, wait for an ally to engage and the enemy to use their abilities, then go in and check which terrain to target with Qiyana W Terrashape when retreating.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain through low-health minions to approach and heal. Don’t leave a half-health minion between you and Irelia, and create distance when a minion is about to die. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait for the blades to disappear.

Karma.build: Build magic resistance first against Karma’s main damage from Q Inner Flame and W Focused Resolve. If the healing from Karma R Mantra-empowered W prevents you from assassinating her, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Karma.combo: First use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element, then dash in with E Audacity when Karma W Focused Resolve has been used. Cast Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash and follow with a basic attack. Then use W Terrashape to target different terrain, reset Q and your passive, and cast Q again. If you have an angle near a wall or the river, first knock Karma into the terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent to stun her, then land your remaining attacks.
Karma.escape: The opening to engage is when Karma W Focused Resolve has been used. If Karma E Inspire or the shield from R Mantra-empowered E is active, wait for it to expire. Before engaging, choose the terrain you’ll target with Qiyana W Terrashape when disengaging.
Karma.fight: When Karma steps forward to last-hit a minion, approach with brush element and Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal for a short trade. Engage with Qiyana E Audacity after Karma W Focused Resolve has been used and the shield from E Inspire has expired. After trading, use Qiyana W Terrashape to target different terrain, then recast Q or disengage.
Karma.laning: Early on, dodge Karma Q Inner Flame and don’t let her poke you from range for long. Look for short back-and-forth trades around brush, and don’t use Qiyana E Audacity to farm. Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river to collect an element and look for opportunities in a side lane or the jungle.
Karma.phase: Early on, Qiyana should avoid extended fights against ranged Karma and stick to short trades. Late game, it becomes harder to kill a target with defensive items in one burst, so avoid risky engages.
Karma.teamfight: Don’t engage first while Karma W Focused Resolve is available; go in after she uses it on an ally. If the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E is on nearby enemies, wait for it to expire. If enemies group by the river or in a narrow passage, use Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent to knock them into terrain. Otherwise, wait for an ally to engage, then dive the backline.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame slows in an area, so dodge it by moving behind minions or out of range. If you’re hit by the flame zone from Karma R Mantra-empowered Q, move outside the circle before it detonates again. If Karma W Focused Resolve tethers you, use Qiyana W Terrashape to create distance before you’re rooted.

Kassadin.build: Build magic resistance first against Kassadin’s attacks. Kassadin W Nether Blade restores mana, not health, so don’t prioritize an anti-heal item.
Kassadin.combo: While holding an element, dash to Kassadin with Qiyana E Audacity and cast Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash, then land a basic attack. Then use Qiyana W Terrashape to get a different element, reset Q and the per-target cooldown of Qiyana P Royal Privilege, and cast Q again. If you have an angle to knock him into a wall, first stun him with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then use W to switch elements and land Q and a basic attack.
Kassadin.escape: If you also confirm that Kassadin E Force Pulse has been used, you can engage while avoiding its slow.
Kassadin.fight: Approach with brush element, dash in with Qiyana E Audacity, and cast Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash to hit him. Save Qiyana W Terrashape for your next Q and your escape route.
Kassadin.laning: Push the wave toward the enemy turret to keep Kassadin occupied, pressure him with your jungler, then move along the river to collect an element. If the wave is pulling toward your side, don’t leave your lane.
Kassadin.phase: Late game, Kassadin can use Kassadin R Riftwalk to enter the backline and escape, so don’t leave yourself exposed alone.
Kassadin.teamfight: If enemies group in a narrow passage, by the river, or near brush, knock them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent to stun them. If there’s no such angle, wait for an ally to engage and the enemy to use their abilities, then enter the backline with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity. Watch that backline allies aren’t left alone within range of Kassadin R Riftwalk, and check which terrain to target when retreating before you go in.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin E Force Pulse slows, and its cooldown is reduced whenever abilities are used near Kassadin.

Leblanc.build: When investing in defense, prioritize magic resistance against LeBlanc’s magic damage. Also consider a spell shield to block the combo that starts with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, and movement speed to leave the area she telegraphs.
Leblanc.combo: While holding an element, dash to LeBlanc with Qiyana E Audacity, cast Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash, then land a basic attack. Next, use Qiyana W Terrashape to get a different element, reset Q and your passive, and cast Q again. If you can knock her into a wall, first stun her with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then switch elements and finish with Q and a basic attack.
Leblanc.escape: After LeBlanc uses W Distortion, check that the window to return to her original position has ended before engaging. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains has also been used, close the gap with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity, then land Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal and Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent.
Leblanc.fight: Before a fight, use Qiyana W Terrashape to get the element you need, then approach briefly with brush element. Engage with Qiyana E Audacity after LeBlanc W Distortion’s return window expires or after she has already used its return, and use your follow-up Qiyana W Terrashape for additional attacks and your escape.
Leblanc.laning: Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river. Alert your team immediately if LeBlanc disappears from mid.
Leblanc.phase: Later, it becomes harder to kill a target in one burst and engaging becomes more dangerous, so fight carefully.
Leblanc.teamfight: If the enemies grouped on LeBlanc’s side are in a narrow passage, by the river, or near brush, start the teamfight by knocking them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there’s no such angle, wait for an ally to engage and for LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains and the enemy’s other abilities to be used, then enter the backline. Before going in, check which terrain to target with Qiyana W Terrashape when retreating.
Leblanc.watch: If the mark from LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice is still on you, her next ability will deal heavy damage, so don’t step forward; back off until the mark disappears. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, use Qiyana W Terrashape or Qiyana E Audacity to get out of range before you’re rooted.

Lissandra.build: Build core items first, but get magic resistance rather than armor to defend against Lissandra’s magic damage. If the enemy composition has a lot of crowd control that can lock Qiyana down, buy Quicksilver Sash after one core item. If Lissandra’s healing prevents you from finishing her, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Lissandra.combo: While holding an element, dash to Lissandra with Qiyana E Audacity and cast Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash, then land a basic attack. Then use Qiyana W Terrashape to get a different element, reset Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal and your passive, then attack again. When the claw from Lissandra E Glacial Path is flying, rooting her with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal using river element can prevent her from recasting it to move.
Lissandra.escape: A good opening to engage is when Lissandra W Ring of Frost has been used and Lissandra E Glacial Path has also been fully spent. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is available, check whether she uses it, since she may stun you or prevent you from finishing her with damage immunity immediately after you engage. Before going in, choose the terrain to target with Qiyana W Terrashape when retreating.
Lissandra.fight: Trade briefly right after Lissandra uses Lissandra W Ring of Frost on the wave or misses it. After Lissandra uses E Glacial Path, close the gap with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity. Before the fight, get brush or river element, and decide which terrain to target with Qiyana W Terrashape when retreating again.
Lissandra.laning: Farm from an angle that avoids the piercing path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard through allied minions. When Lissandra W Ring of Frost has been used, approach with brush element for a short trade, then escape by using Qiyana W Terrashape to target different terrain. Before moving, push the wave toward the enemy turret, then travel along the river.
Lissandra.phase: Early on, Qiyana should focus on short trades when Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down rather than extended fights. Later, it becomes harder to kill a target in one burst and engaging becomes more dangerous, so use your midgame lead to take objectives and turrets.
Lissandra.teamfight: Check whether Lissandra E Glacial Path and Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb have been used before engaging. If enemies group by the river or in a narrow passage, start the teamfight by knocking them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there’s no such angle, wait for an ally to engage and for Lissandra’s crowd control to be used, then enter the backline with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity.

Lux.build: The information doesn’t specify a particular item to buy first, so the purchase order can’t be determined. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Lux’s damage, and consider movement speed to leave the area telegraphed by Lux E Lucent Singularity.
Lux.combo: While holding an element, if Lux Q Light Binding misses, engage with Qiyana E Audacity and press Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash, then land a basic attack. Next, use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element from different terrain, reset Q and your passive, and cast Q again. If you can knock Lux toward a wall, first stun her with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then use W to switch elements and land Q and a basic attack.
Lux.escape: The opening to engage is right after Lux Q Light Binding has been used. Lux has no ability to create distance on her own, so close in with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity then and attack before she can create distance again.
Lux.fight: The moment you bait and dodge Lux Q Light Binding, close the gap with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity. Before the fight, decide whether to approach with brush element or catch her with the root from river element, and position near the corresponding terrain. After a short burst of damage, keep an escape route open with Qiyana W Terrashape.
Lux.laning: Lux Q Light Binding can hit up to two targets in front of her, so don’t stand directly in line with an ally. Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river to collect an element.
Lux.phase: Early on, Qiyana struggles to fight ranged opponents for long, so dodge Lux Q Light Binding and stick to short trades. Later, engaging becomes dangerous, so use your midgame lead to take objectives and turrets and close out the game sooner.
Lux.teamfight: If Lux and the other enemies group by the river, in a narrow passage, or near brush, start the teamfight by knocking them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there’s no such angle, wait for an ally to engage and for Lux Q Light Binding and defensive abilities to be used, then enter the backline from the flank. Approach from a different direction than your allies so Lux E Lucent Singularity doesn’t catch you all together, and check which terrain to target with Qiyana W Terrashape when retreating before you go in.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, her follow-up abilities will follow, so bait it out and dodge before engaging. Leave the area targeted by Lux E Lucent Singularity, and sidestep when the red targeting line from Lux R Final Spark appears. If one of Lux’s abilities hits you, immediately create distance so she can’t detonate the Illumination mark with a basic attack.

Malzahar.build: Build magic resistance first against Malzahar Q Call of the Void, W Void Swarm, and E Malefic Visions. Against the suppression from Malzahar R Nether Grasp, get Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar. R deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase your health.
Malzahar.combo: Use Qiyana W Terrashape to get brush element, then first remove Malzahar P Void Shift with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. Next, dash in with Qiyana E Audacity and cast Q during the dash, then land a basic attack. Use the Qiyana W Terrashape you saved to get an element from different terrain, reset Q and your passive, then cast Q again.
Malzahar.escape: Engage after dodging the silence from Malzahar Q Call of the Void and when the voidlings from Malzahar W Void Swarm have disappeared. Malzahar has no ability to create distance, so close in with Qiyana E Audacity, but save Qiyana W Terrashape for your next Q and your escape route. If Malzahar R Nether Grasp is available, don’t engage alone in an area without vision.
Malzahar.fight: After removing Malzahar P Void Shift with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, trade briefly once you dodge the silence from Malzahar Q Call of the Void. Approach with brush element, land Qiyana E Audacity and Q, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to target different terrain and escape. If the voidlings from Malzahar W Void Swarm are already out, clear them first.
Malzahar.laning: Don’t stand near a minion afflicted by Malzahar E Malefic Visions when it dies. If Malzahar pushes the lane and steps forward, remove P Void Shift with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal and target him with your jungler. Before moving, push the wave toward the enemy turret, then follow the river to collect an element.
Malzahar.phase: Early on, pressure Malzahar so he has no time to build up Malzahar W Void Swarm, and trade short bursts of damage instead of taking extended fights. Malzahar gets stronger over time and Qiyana’s engages become more dangerous, so use your midgame lead to take objectives and turrets and close out the game sooner.
Malzahar.teamfight: First check whether Malzahar P Void Shift is active and whether the voidlings from W Void Swarm remain. If enemies group near terrain by the river or in a narrow passage, knock them into it with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent to stun them. Otherwise, wait for an ally to engage and for Malzahar’s crowd control to be used, then enter the backline. Before going in, check which terrain to target with Qiyana W Terrashape when retreating.
Malzahar.watch: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, damage and crowd control won’t affect him well, so remove it first with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal before engaging. When you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, dodge outside the two portals and engage after the silence ends. Malzahar R Nether Grasp’s suppression can’t be removed with Qiyana W Terrashape or E Audacity, so don’t enter an area without vision alone while Malzahar can cast R.

Mel.build: The first item can’t be determined from the information provided. If you need defense, prioritize magic resistance over armor, and consider movement speed to get out of Mel’s area attacks.
Mel.combo: Use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element, then dash to Mel with Qiyana E Audacity while casting Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. After an auto attack, use Qiyana W Terrashape on different terrain to reset Q and your passive, then use Q again. If you can push her into a wall, stun her first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then follow up with the rest of your attacks.
Mel.escape: Mel has no mobility, so go in when Mel E Solar Snare and Mel W Rebuttal are down. Close in with Qiyana E Audacity, but check which terrain you can use for a Q reset and escape before using Qiyana W Terrashape.
Mel.fight: Dodge Mel E Solar Snare sideways, then go in briefly after Mel W Rebuttal is down. Approach with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal while holding the brush element and Qiyana E Audacity, land an auto attack, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to get another element and escape.
Mel.laning: Early on, trade briefly when Mel steps forward to last-hit minions, and avoid extended fights. Push the wave toward Mel’s turret, then move along the river to find an element and opportunities in other lanes. Pressure Mel to limit the time she has to build growth stacks.
Mel.phase: Early on, pressure Mel by exploiting her low armor and lack of mobility. As the game goes on, Mel builds up growth and Qiyana’s engages become more dangerous.
Mel.teamfight: If Mel groups with allies near the river or a narrow passage, start the fight by pushing them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there’s no such angle, let your allies engage first, then enter the backline after Mel E Solar Snare and Mel W Rebuttal are used. Before going in, check which terrain you’ll use Qiyana W Terrashape on when retreating.
Mel.watch: Dodge Mel E Solar Snare sideways; if it hits you near the center of the orb, you’ll be rooted and easily hit by Mel Q Radiant Volley. Don’t throw Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal while Mel W Rebuttal is active. If Mel’s Overwhelm stacks remain, watch out for Mel R Golden Eclipse even after retreating far away.

Naafiri.build: Build armor first against Naafiri’s damage, and get health as well. If healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and E Eviscerate extends the fight, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Naafiri.combo: While holding an element, engage with Qiyana E Audacity, press Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash to hit, then land a basic attack. Next, use Qiyana W Terrashape to get a different element, reset Q and your passive, and cast Q once more. If you have an angle to knock her into a wall, first stun her with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then land your remaining attacks.
Naafiri.escape: Engage after Naafiri has used both Q Darkin Daggers and E Eviscerate, especially before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes back. If only one of her mobility abilities has been used, wait, since she can escape with the other. Also wait for Naafiri W The Call of the Pack to end before closing in with Qiyana E Audacity.
Naafiri.fight: Use Qiyana W Terrashape to get brush element, then approach briefly to trade, and scout the next terrain to target with W and your escape route in advance. Right after Naafiri E Eviscerate revives the pack, clear it with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal before counterattacking.
Naafiri.laning: When Naafiri steps forward to last-hit a minion, trade briefly around brush, then back off. If you’ve pushed the wave toward the enemy turret, move along the river to collect an element. If the wave has pulled toward your side, don’t leave lane.
Naafiri.phase: Qiyana’s damage output is strong in the midgame, but Naafiri’s roams are also dangerous, so secure vision and turn your lead into objectives and turrets. Later, don’t get caught while alone; group and fight with your team.
Naafiri.teamfight: If enemies group by the river, in a narrow passage, or near brush, knock them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there’s no such angle, wait for an ally to engage and the enemy to use their abilities, then enter the backline. Check which terrain to target with Qiyana W Terrashape when retreating. Immediately back off after an ally dies, since Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit can be used again.
Naafiri.watch: If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits you once, create distance until the bleed ends to avoid her second Q and the pack’s attacks. While Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, she can’t be targeted, so use Qiyana E Audacity after it ends.

Neeko.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Neeko’s main damage. If you’re likely to be rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and killed by Neeko R Pop Blossom, prioritize tenacity. If the enemy team has a lot of crowd control that can lock down Qiyana, buy Quicksilver Sash after one core item.
Neeko.combo: Before engaging, use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element. While dashing to Neeko with Qiyana E Audacity, press Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, then land an auto attack. Next, use Qiyana W Terrashape on different terrain to reset Q and your passive, then use Q once more. If you can push Neeko into a wall, stun her first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then switch elements and finish with Q and an auto attack.
Neeko.escape: Close the gap with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity while Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down or Neeko R Pop Blossom is unavailable. Before engaging, check which terrain you can use Qiyana W Terrashape on after attacking to retreat.
Neeko.fight: The moment after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used is your window to engage. Take the brush element, approach briefly, then attack with Qiyana E Audacity and Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. Use Qiyana W Terrashape on different terrain to escape.
Neeko.laning: Early on, don’t fight a ranged opponent for long. Trade briefly only when Neeko steps forward to last-hit minions or just after she uses Neeko E Tangle-Barbs. Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river to get an element. If the wave is pulling toward your side, don’t leave your lane.
Neeko.phase: After learning Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, you can stun enemies using terrain, and you’re strong in midgame as you get one or two core items. Engaging becomes more dangerous late, so use your midgame lead to pressure objectives and turrets.
Neeko.teamfight: If someone you suspect is a transformed Neeko approaches, spread out from your allies in anticipation of Neeko R Pop Blossom, and don’t chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter. If the enemy team groups near the river or brush, push them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there’s no such angle, let your allies engage first, then enter the backline with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity after the enemy abilities are used.
Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows larger and faster after hitting the first target, so don’t stand on top of an ally. If Neeko approaches while transformed, you may not see the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom, so create distance as soon as you suspect who it is.

Orianna.build: Orianna deals magic damage, so choose magic resistance if you’re buying resistance. Also prioritize movement speed so you can get out of areas where Orianna has placed her abilities.
Orianna.combo: Use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element, then engage with Qiyana E Audacity while pressing Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal to hit her, followed by an auto attack. Then use Qiyana W Terrashape to get a different element and use Q and Qiyana P Royal Privilege again. If you can push her into a wall, stun her first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then follow up with the rest of your attacks.
Orianna.escape: Orianna has no innate mobility, so engage when the ball is away from her and Orianna W Command: Dissonance or Orianna R Command: Shockwave is down. Before going in, check which terrain you will target with Qiyana W Terrashape to retreat.
Orianna.fight: Just after Orianna Q Command: Attack moves the ball away from her, use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element and Qiyana E Audacity to close the gap. Deal brief damage, then use Qiyana W Terrashape on different terrain to use Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal again and escape.
Orianna.laning: Early on, don’t let Orianna land a string of auto attacks on you. Trade briefly when she steps forward to last-hit minions. Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river to get an element.
Orianna.phase: It becomes harder to kill an opponent in one burst late in the game, so convert your midgame lead into objectives and turrets.
Orianna.teamfight: If the enemy team groups near the river, a narrow passage, or brush, push them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there’s no such angle, let your allies engage first, then enter the backline after Orianna W Command: Dissonance, Orianna E Command: Protect, and Orianna R Command: Shockwave have been used.
Orianna.watch: Watch where Orianna’s ball is with Orianna Q Command: Attack, and avoid the area around it so Orianna R Command: Shockwave can’t pull you in. Also watch out for the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance and the string of auto attacks empowered by Orianna P Clockwork Windup.

Sylas.build: If Sylas sustains through fights with W Kingslayer, fit Executioner's Calling between core items. If you’re buying resistance against Sylas’s damage, get magic resistance rather than armor.
Sylas.combo: Before the fight, use Qiyana W Terrashape to get the brush element. While dashing to Sylas with Qiyana E Audacity, use Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. Land an auto attack, then use the saved Qiyana W Terrashape on different terrain to get another element, reset Q and your passive, and use Q once more. If you can push Sylas toward terrain, stun him first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then switch elements with W and finish with Q and an auto attack.
Sylas.escape: Don’t go in just because Sylas used the first dash of E Abscond / Abduct; engage after dodging the second chain. Sylas W Kingslayer is also a mobility ability, so having only E down doesn’t mean his escape is blocked. In particular, close the gap with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity before Sylas E Abscond / Abduct comes back up, then lock him down with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal or R Supreme Display of Talent.
Sylas.fight: After dodging the second chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, trade briefly, especially before E comes back up. Close in with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal while holding the brush element and Qiyana E Audacity, and save Qiyana W Terrashape for your next Q and escape route. If Sylas W Kingslayer is available, avoid trades that only take him to around half health and leave the finish for later.
Sylas.laning: At this point, Qiyana should also look for brief trades when Sylas steps forward to last-hit minions instead of extended fights. Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river to get an element for the next fight.
Sylas.phase: Qiyana’s assassination and engages become harder late in the game, so use your midgame lead to take objectives and turrets.
Sylas.teamfight: If Sylas engages with E Abscond / Abduct, catch him with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal or R Supreme Display of Talent and attack before he can heal with W Kingslayer. If the enemy team groups near the river, brush, or a narrow passage, start a team fight by pushing them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there’s no such angle, let your allies engage first, then enter the backline after the enemy abilities are used. Before going in, use Qiyana W Terrashape to check which terrain you can retreat to.
Sylas.watch: Be more wary of the second chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct than the first dash. If the chain hits, Sylas pulls himself to you and knocks you up, so time Qiyana W Terrashape to dodge the chain. Sylas Q Chain Lash explodes late at the intersection, so move away from there even if the first chain only grazes you.

Talon.build: Get cheap armor early, such as Cloth Armor, against Talon’s damage. Later, build both armor and health to improve your durability. If healing from Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy prevents you from assassinating him, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Talon.combo: First, get an element with Qiyana W Terrashape. When Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is down, engage with Qiyana E Audacity. While dashing, use Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, then land an auto attack. Use Qiyana W Terrashape to get a different element, reset Q and your passive, and use Q again. If you can push him into terrain, stun him first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then switch elements with W and finish with Q and an auto attack.
Talon.escape: The moment after you bait Talon into using Q Noxian Diplomacy is your window to engage with Qiyana W Terrashape and E Audacity. If Talon R Shadow Assault is also down, look for a window when he can’t use stealth to escape. Before going in, check which terrain you can use Qiyana W Terrashape on again and your escape route.
Talon.fight: Immediately after Talon uses Q Noxian Diplomacy, close the gap with Qiyana W Terrashape and E Audacity. Trade briefly with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal while holding the brush element, then use the saved Qiyana W Terrashape to get a different element and escape. Once you confirm Talon R Shadow Assault is down, you have a chance to pressure him again.
Talon.laning: Share Talon’s position with your team when he roams and ward jungle routes. Before moving, push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river.
Talon.phase: Early on, watch out for Talon’s burst and take only brief trades. Engaging recklessly also becomes dangerous for Qiyana late, so use your midgame lead to pressure objectives and turrets.
Talon.teamfight: If the enemy team groups in a narrow passage or near the river, stun them by pushing them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there’s no such angle, let your allies engage first, then enter the backline after the enemy abilities are used. If Talon reaches your backline, group with your allies and catch him with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal and R Supreme Display of Talent.
Talon.watch: If Talon W Rake hits you, move out of its return path to prevent his passive stacks and bleed from triggering. While Talon R Shadow Assault is available, watch for him to use stealth to escape or counterattack.

TwistedFate.build: Consider magic resistance first for defense. Twisted Fate deals magic damage, so magic resistance is more effective than armor. Movement speed is also useful for getting out of the area of his telegraphed attacks.
TwistedFate.combo: After getting an element with Qiyana W Terrashape, engage with E Audacity and press Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal while dashing to hit Twisted Fate.
