Weave in an auto attack, then use W Terrashape to get a different element, reset Q and your passive, and use Q again. If you can push him into a wall, stun him first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then follow up with the rest of your attacks.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate uses the yellow card from W Pick a Card is your chance to go in with Qiyana E Audacity. Before engaging, use W Terrashape to check which terrain you can use when retreating.
TwistedFate.fight: Delay your engage while Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s yellow card is ready. When he has used the card or is holding a blue or red card, get an element with Qiyana W Terrashape, close the gap with E Audacity, and trade briefly.
TwistedFate.laning: Early on, avoid extended fights and use the brush element for a brief trade when Twisted Fate steps forward to last-hit minions. Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river to get an element. Alert your allies immediately if Twisted Fate looks ready to roam with R Destiny.
TwistedFate.phase: Early on, Qiyana should avoid extended fights with ranged opponents and focus on brief trades. Late in the game, it becomes harder to kill opponents with stacked defensive items in one go, so choose your engages carefully.
TwistedFate.teamfight: After Twisted Fate uses the yellow card from W Pick a Card, approach him in the backline with Qiyana W Terrashape and E Audacity. If the enemy team groups near the river or in a narrow passage, look to stun them by pushing them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If you see Twisted Fate use R Destiny nearby, interrupt his movement with the root from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal or R Supreme Display of Talent.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate has locked in the yellow card with W Pick a Card, one auto attack will stun you, so stay outside his attack range.

Veigar.build: All of Veigar’s damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance over armor. Get movement speed early, too, so you can walk out of the telegraphed area of Veigar W Dark Matter.
Veigar.combo: Use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element, then dash to Veigar with Qiyana E Audacity and cast Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash. Weave in a basic attack, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element from different terrain, reset Q and your passive, and cast Q again. If you have an angle to push him into a wall, stun him first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then switch elements and finish with Q and basic attacks.
Veigar.escape: Veigar has no mobility, so the moment Veigar E Event Horizon is down is Qiyana’s chance to engage. If you’re trapped by E, don’t rush toward the edge. Move around inside and save Qiyana W Terrashape or Qiyana E Audacity for your escape route.
Veigar.fight: Qiyana’s physical damage is effective against Veigar’s low armor, so apply brief pressure early. When Veigar E Event Horizon is down, enter with an element using Qiyana E Audacity, and cast Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash. Keep moving even while landing basic attacks so you can dodge Veigar W Dark Matter.
Veigar.laning: Veigar Q Baleful Strike pierces only the first two units it hits, so use minion positioning to avoid its poke. Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river to find an element and opportunities in other lanes.
Veigar.phase: After learning Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent and during the mid game as core items come online, use terrain to secure kills and gains on objectives and turrets. Veigar keeps growing stronger through stacks, so the longer the game goes, the worse it is for Qiyana.
Veigar.teamfight: When enemies group near a narrow passage, the river, or brush, use Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent to push them into terrain and stun them. If there’s no such angle, let your allies engage first, then enter the backline with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity after Veigar E Event Horizon is down. Before going in, check Veigar’s position and which terrain you’ll target with Qiyana W Terrashape when you retreat.
Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns you when you cross its edge, so if you’re trapped inside, don’t blindly run out. Move around inside and wait for it to disappear. Veigar W Dark Matter shows where and when it will land, so watch the ground indicator and dodge to the side. When your health is low, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which deals more damage based on your missing health.

Vex.build: Get movement speed early so you can walk out of Vex’s telegraphed area attacks. Build magic resistance against Vex’s damage, and consider tenacity because you risk being feared after dashing in.
Vex.combo: First use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element, then engage with E Audacity when Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is down. Cast Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash, aim it at Vex, and land a basic attack. Then use W Terrashape to get an element from different terrain and cast Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal again. If you have an angle to push Vex into terrain, stun her first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then follow up with the rest of your attacks.
Vex.escape: Go in during the window when both Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear and the shield from W Personal Space are down.
Vex.fight: Engage when Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is down and the shield from W Personal Space is gone. Approach with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal using the brush element, then make a short trade with E Audacity and Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. Save Qiyana W Terrashape to secure your next element and escape route.
Vex.laning: Avoid extended trades early; make short trades when Vex steps forward to last-hit. Don’t use Qiyana E Audacity to farm, and before casting Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, check whether there’s terrain you can target with W Terrashape. Push the wave toward Vex’s turret, then move along the river to secure an element.
Vex.phase: Qiyana struggles with extended trades early, so focus on short trades. Later, it becomes harder to kill opponents with defensive items in one go, so choose your engages carefully.
Vex.teamfight: If Vex R Shadow Surge marks an ally, move toward them and position to counter Vex’s dash together. Move low-health allies out of Vex’s range first to prevent her from chaining casts of R Shadow Surge.
Vex.watch: If Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is ready, don’t dash in with Qiyana E Audacity or W Terrashape. Look for the moment right after Vex uses P Doom 'n Gloom on the wave or to poke. If your dash applies the Gloom mark, move out of Vex’s basic attack range and wait for the mark to disappear.

Viktor.combo: Use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element, then cast Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal while dashing to Viktor with Qiyana E Audacity. Land a basic attack, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to get a different element, reset Q and your passive, and cast Q again. If you can push Viktor toward a wall, stun him first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then switch elements and land Q and a basic attack.
Viktor.escape: Engage when Viktor W Gravity Field is down or when you can get out of its area. Viktor has no dash to escape on his own, so close the distance with Qiyana E Audacity and catch him with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. Before going in, also check which terrain you can target with Qiyana W Terrashape when you retreat.
Viktor.fight: Look for a moment when Viktor steps forward to last-hit or uses Viktor E Hextech Ray on the wave. Approach with the brush element from Qiyana W Terrashape, then make a short trade with Qiyana E Audacity and Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. If Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, use Qiyana W Terrashape to get out and avoid the stun.
Viktor.laning: Early on, don’t stand in the path Viktor uses to clear the wave with E Hextech Ray. Look for short trades from brush instead of extended fights. After pushing the wave toward Viktor’s turret, move along the river to secure an element with Qiyana W Terrashape and create advantages elsewhere. If the wave has been pulled toward your side, don’t leave your position.
Viktor.phase: Early on, pressure Viktor before he has evolution stacks with short trades. The more stacks Viktor P Glorious Evolution gains later, the harder it becomes to kill him with the same engage.
Viktor.teamfight: If Viktor is near terrain by the river or a narrow passage, look for an angle to push him with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent and stun him. If there’s no such angle, let your allies engage first, then enter the backline with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity after Viktor’s abilities, such as W Gravity Field, have been used. Before engaging, check which terrain you can target with Qiyana W Terrashape to escape.
Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so don’t stand in line with the wave; dodge to the side. When Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, use Qiyana W Terrashape to get out immediately and don’t keep trading inside it. Viktor Q Siphon Power grants a shield and movement speed, so reassess the distance and damage right after he uses it.

Vladimir.build: Get magic resistance first against Vladimir’s main damage. If his healing prevents you from assassinating him, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Vladimir.combo: Pressure Vladimir with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal using the brush element to draw out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool. When the pool ends, use Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent to push him into a wall and stun him, then dash in with Qiyana E Audacity and land Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal and a basic attack. Use Qiyana W Terrashape to get a different element, reset Q and Qiyana P Royal Privilege, then attack again.
Vladimir.escape: The decisive engage window is immediately after Vladimir has used W Sanguine Pool and the pool ends. You can also close the distance with Qiyana E Audacity when Vladimir slows down while charging E Tides of Blood, but watch minion positions to avoid being slowed.
Vladimir.fight: Don’t rush to use Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent while Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is available. Apply brief pressure to draw out the pool, then close in with Qiyana E Audacity as it ends and land Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal and basic attacks.
Vladimir.laning: Use Qiyana W Terrashape to secure the brush element and an escape route, then push the wave toward the enemy turret and move along the river.
Vladimir.phase: Later, Qiyana’s engages become riskier, and it becomes harder to kill a scaled Vladimir in one go.
Vladimir.teamfight: Spread out so multiple allies aren’t hit by Vladimir R Hemoplague, and if you’re infected, close in after its effect ends. If the enemy team groups near terrain by the river or in a narrow passage, use Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent to push them into it and stun them. If there’s no such angle, let your allies engage first, then enter the backline after the enemy abilities are used. Check which terrain you can target with Qiyana W Terrashape when you retreat.
Vladimir.watch: Watch out for the empowered damage and healing from Vladimir Q Transfusion. When Vladimir charges E Tides of Blood, stand behind minions or move out of range. If Vladimir R Hemoplague infects you, you’ll take increased damage, so step back until the effect ends.

Xerath.build: Get a way to cleanse or remove the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb first. If you build resistance, get magic resistance against Xerath’s attacks, and consider movement speed to help you get out of telegraphed attack areas.
Xerath.combo: Get an element with Qiyana W Terrashape from brush, then cast Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal while dashing to Xerath with Qiyana E Audacity. Land a basic attack, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element from different terrain and cast Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal again. If you get an angle to push Xerath into terrain, stun him first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then switch elements and attack.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so the window to engage is when Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. You can also dodge attacks and engage while Xerath is unable to move as he channels R Rite of the Arcane. Before going in, check which terrain you can target with Qiyana W Terrashape when you retreat.
Xerath.fight: Close the distance right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. Use Qiyana W Terrashape to get the element you need, engage with Qiyana E Audacity and attack briefly, then use the Qiyana W Terrashape you saved to switch elements and secure an escape route.
Xerath.laning: Early on, don’t fight for long against Xerath’s long range; avoid heavy damage while farming. When Xerath charges Q Arcanopulse, dodge to the side and look for a chance to close the distance. After Xerath spends a lot of mana, push the lane and call your jungler. When you roam, push the wave toward the enemy turret first.
Xerath.phase: Qiyana is strongest in the mid game, so push the lane and move along the river to keep building an advantage through objectives and turrets. Later, it becomes harder to kill opponents with defensive items in one go, so choose your engages more carefully.
Xerath.teamfight: If Xerath and the enemy team are grouped near a narrow passage, the river, or brush, start a team fight by using Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent to push them into terrain. If there’s no such angle, let your allies engage first, then enter the backline with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity after enemy abilities such as Xerath E Shocking Orb have been used. Before going in, check which terrain you can target when you retreat.
Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse pierces minions, so you aren’t safe behind them. When he starts charging, change direction and dodge to the side. If Xerath E Shocking Orb stuns you, he can follow up with more attacks, so don’t dive deep with Qiyana E Audacity before this ability is down.

Yasuo.build: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath deal physical damage, so build armor first. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade deals magic damage, which armor won’t block, and attack speed reduction also slows the cooldown of Yasuo Q Steel Tempest.
Yasuo.combo: Use Qiyana W Terrashape to get the brush element and engage with Qiyana E Audacity, then cast Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal during the dash to hit Yasuo. Weave in a basic attack, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to get a different element, reset Q and your passive, and cast Q again. If you have an angle to push him into a wall, stun him first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then continue with the rest of your attacks.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, his Q Steel Tempest stacks reset, giving you a chance to engage. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade has a short cooldown, so you aren’t safe just because he used it once. Catch him as you go in with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal or Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up.
Yasuo.fight: First remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with light poke, then start trading. Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, close the distance with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity, catch him with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, and attack briefly.
Yasuo.laning: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions as stepping stones, so manage the wave to keep it thin and pushing toward your side, limiting his approach paths. For trades, approach with the brush element and save Qiyana W Terrashape to escape to different terrain. After pushing the wave toward the enemy turret, move along the river to secure an element.
Yasuo.phase: Later, it becomes harder to kill opponents with defensive items in one go, so use your mid-game lead to pressure objectives and turrets.
Yasuo.teamfight: Watch out for Yasuo’s tornado. If the enemy team groups near the river, a narrow passage, or brush, start a team fight by pushing them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there’s no such angle, let your allies engage first, then enter the backline with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity after the enemy abilities are used. Before going in, check which terrain you can target with Qiyana W Terrashape when you retreat.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so move to the side to dodge when he approaches. If Yasuo has hit Q Steel Tempest twice and prepared a tornado, watch out for the knock-up. Save Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal when facing Yasuo W Wind Wall.

Yone.build: The source doesn’t specify a first purchase item, so no particular item can be recommended. Yone deals mixed damage, so don’t focus on only one resistance. Consider attack speed reduction to slow the cycle of Yone Q Mortal Steel and movement speed to get out of telegraphed attack areas.
Yone.combo: With the ice element, follow up with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal while dashing to Yone with Qiyana E Audacity to root him. Land a basic attack, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to get an element from different terrain, reset Q and Qiyana P Royal Privilege’s target-specific cooldown, and cast Q again. If you have an angle to push him into a wall, cast Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent first to stun him, then switch elements and land Q and a basic attack.
Yone.escape: Engage after the stacks on Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado have disappeared and Yone E Soul Unbound and Yone R Fate Sealed are down. If Yone has already engaged in spirit form, look for a chance to stop his return with the ice root from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal or the stun from Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent.
Yone.fight: Trade briefly when Yone’s Q Mortal Steel tornado stacks have disappeared or when Yone engages first with E Soul Unbound. Use Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal with the ice element from the river to stop Yone from returning, and save Qiyana W Terrashape for your next Q and escape route.
Yone.laning: Back off when Yone’s tornado is ready. Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river to secure an element.
Yone.phase: Later, it becomes harder to kill opponents with defensive items in one go, so use your mid-game lead to pressure objectives and turrets.
Yone.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave doesn’t gain a larger shield, and check that you aren’t the rearmost ally standing alone in the path of Yone R Fate Sealed. If the enemy team groups near terrain by the river or a narrow passage, push them into it with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent and stun them. If there’s no such angle, let your allies engage first and use Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity to enter the backline after the enemy abilities are used.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare a tornado, wait out of range until the stacks disappear. After Yone E Soul Unbound takes him in, he can deal extra damage when he returns, so create distance before your health gets low.

Zed.build: Build armor early against Zed’s main damage from Zed Q Razor Shuriken, Zed E Shadow Slash, and Zed R Death Mark. Armor won’t block the damage from Zed P Contempt for the Weak, which scales with your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
Zed.combo: With an element, cast Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal while dashing to Zed with Qiyana E Audacity, then land a basic attack. Follow with Qiyana W Terrashape to target different terrain, reset Q and Qiyana P Royal Privilege’s target-specific cooldown, then cast Q again. If you can push Zed into terrain, stun him first with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, then switch elements and land Q and a basic attack.
Zed.escape: Don’t engage just because Zed W Living Shadow is down; check whether Zed can still use R Death Mark. In particular, before Zed R Death Mark comes back up, close the distance with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity, and catch him with the root from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal and the stun from Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent.
Zed.fight: Trade briefly after Zed W Living Shadow is down and the shadow has disappeared, or after Zed has already swapped positions. Prepare the brush element, go in with Qiyana E Audacity, and land Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. Then use Qiyana W Terrashape to target different terrain and secure another attack or an escape route.
Zed.laning: Avoid extended fights early; make short trades when Zed steps forward to last-hit. When roaming, push the wave toward Zed’s turret, then move along the river to secure an element.
Zed.phase: Early on, focus on short trades and don’t give Zed an advantage. Later, Qiyana’s engages become riskier and Zed has a harder time finding a target to pick off alone, so move with your allies.
Zed.teamfight: When Zed enters with R Death Mark, root or stun him with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal or Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent so he can’t stack more damage before the mark detonates. If the enemy team groups near the river or a narrow passage, push them into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. Otherwise, let your allies engage first and enter the backline after the enemy abilities are used. Before going in, check which terrain you can target with Qiyana W Terrashape when you retreat.
Zed.watch: Watch the position of Zed W Living Shadow and move out of the slow area of Zed E Shadow Slash. If Zed R Death Mark is on you, stop Zed from stacking more damage with the root from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal or the stun from Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent.

Zoe.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor to prepare for Zoe’s magic damage. However, resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, so prioritize movement speed to dodge sleep and use health to survive if needed.
Zoe.combo: First use Qiyana W Terrashape to get the element you need, then press Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal while dashing toward Zoe with Qiyana E Audacity. After an auto attack, use Qiyana W Terrashape to get a different element, reset Q and Qiyana P Royal Privilege, and cast Q again. If Zoe is near a wall, knock her into it with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent to stun her, then switch elements and finish with Q and an auto attack.
Zoe.escape: Right after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, look for an opportunity to go in with Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity.
Zoe.fight: Right after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, approach with Qiyana E Audacity while holding an element. If Zoe uses Zoe R Portal Jump, target her starting point rather than chasing where she moves. Once you’re in range, weave in an auto attack, then use Qiyana W Terrashape to change elements and use Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal and Qiyana P Royal Privilege again.
Zoe.laning: Early on, don’t trade at length with ranged Zoe. Briefly approach with the brush element when she steps forward to last-hit a minion. Trade with Qiyana E Audacity and Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal, then use Qiyana W Terrashape on different terrain as you retreat. Push the wave toward the enemy turret, then move along the river to secure elements and opportunities to gain an advantage elsewhere on the map.
Zoe.phase: Around mid game, when you’re starting to get your first core items, actively create advantages and convert them into objectives and turrets. In the late game, it becomes harder to kill opponents with a single burst once they have defensive items, and engaging becomes riskier.
Zoe.teamfight: If Zoe is near a narrow passage, the river, or brush, start the fight by knocking her into terrain with Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. If there’s no such angle, wait for your allies to engage and for Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble to be down, then use Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity to reach the back line. Before going in, check which terrain you’ll use when retreating. If Zoe uses Zoe R Portal Jump, target her starting point.
Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, sleep triggers after a short delay, so move behind a wall or an ally first to get out of Zoe Q Paddle Star!’s angle and range. Even a bubble that misses remains as a trap, so watch for narrow paths with no vision and brush entrances. When you see Zoe winding up Zoe Q Paddle Star!, root her with Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal while holding the ice element to stop her from redirecting it.
